title: run_matrix.py --ym arg + bronze month filter + matrix watermark advance
objective: Add --ym YYYY-MM to etl4/bench/run_matrix.py. Required when --source is s3|zenodo|rest; synthetic defaults to the SYN-002A sentinel (architecture 2.3). Bronze filter by date=YYYY-MM-* when the tree has date= subdirs. Thread ym through write_run and advance the ('matrix','pipeline_runs') watermark per calendar ym after all method cells commit.

contract_deviations: AC-5 interpretation: architecture 2.3 and the DDL CHECK regex EXCLUDE SYN-<seed_hex> from pipeline_watermarks. The synthetic path therefore skips watermark write and logs the skip. AC-5 as literally worded is satisfied only via a real-source run; this is a design-intent alignment, not a bug. Advisor concurred: surrogate calendar months or try/except around CheckViolation are anti-patterns.

Minimum-impact fix: add '--ym', 'SYN-002A' to the monkeypatched argv (or switch to --source synthetic). Could not patch per task 'Do NOT touch Any test file' constraint. notes: Implementation details: (a) --bronze dropped required=True and is checked manually AFTER --ym so argparse surfaces the actionable 'ym required' message when both are missing. (b) _advance_matrix_watermark gates on calendar ym and non-None run_ids (no sink crash on dev without Postgres). It also calls watermark.get() first and refuses to roll the high-water backwards. (c) Bronze month filter uses path.glob('date={ym}-*/**/*.parquet') and only triggers when ym is calendar and the dir has date= children; synthetic flat-plus-date trees are unaffected (the synthetic default ym SYN-002A never matches _YM_CALENDAR_RE). (d) The watermark set is in its own short-lived connection after pass 2 completes, not folded into write_run's txn, because write_run's CTE is per-cell and the watermark is per-matrix-run.
